glosses: authority (power to enforce rules or give orders)
authorities (bodies that have power and control in a particular sphere)

examples.en: He's an authority in his field.
I have the authority to do this.

examples.text: Con quale autorità mi ordini di fare ciò?
examples.en: By what authority do you order me to do this?

examples.text: È una grande autorità in economia.
examples.en: He is a great authority on economics.
